The short question that arises for consideration of this Court is whether the acquisition proceedings initiated under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and culminated into the Award under Section 11A of the said Act and the said Award having been set aside by this Court in a Writ Petition filed by the Municipal Corporation, 2/3 12.4890.22 wp.doc with a direction to remand the proceedings for making a fresh Award, which Award admittedly is made after 1st January 2014 would be an Award under the provisions of the The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 or it would be an Award under Section 11A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
2.

sentences.text: 3. In view of the rival claims made by the parties in the compensation awarded by the Special Land Acquisition Officer in respect of the Writ property, at this stage, we do not propose to pass any order for apportionment or for withdrawal of the amount.
In our view, the issue formulated aforesaid will have to be decided first before passing any order for apportionment of the amount or to 3/3

4. Place the matter on admission board on 19 th June 2023.
If the Affidavits are not filed by any of the Respondent, same shall be filed before the next date.

opennyai_summary.issue:
The short question that arises for consideration of this Court is whether the acquisition proceedings initiated under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and culminated into the Award under Section 11A of the said Act and the said Award having been set aside by this Court in a Writ Petition filed by the Municipal Corporation, 2/3 12.4890.22 wp.doc with a direction to remand the proceedings for making a fresh Award, which Award admittedly is made after 1st January 2014 would be an Award under the provisions of the The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 or it would be an Award under Section 11A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
2.
Depending upon the outcome of the issue formulated aforesaid, this Court will have to decide whether the Reference made by the Collector under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 in view of the claim made by Respondent No. 4 would be maintainable or the remedy of the party for apportionment or enhancement would be under Section 64 of the The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
opennyai_summary.decision:
3. In view of the rival claims made by the parties in the compensation awarded by the Special Land Acquisition Officer in respect of the Writ property, at this stage, we do not propose to pass any order for apportionment or for withdrawal of the amount.
In our view, the issue formulated aforesaid will have to be decided first before passing any order for apportionment of the amount or to 3/3
grant liberty to the Petitioner to withdraw the amount deposited by the Municipal Corporation in the Reference Court.
4. Place the matter on admission board on 19 th June 2023.
If the Affidavits are not filed by any of the Respondent, same shall be filed before the next date.
